name: Bekaa Valley

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

soil.rock: Limestone makes alkaline soil that drains well yet can hold water for the vines. It is usually planted to grapes valued for their acidity.

land: The high ground runs about 13°F cooler than the low ground. Higher vineyards ripen later and keep more acidity, so one grape can make lighter or richer wine here depending on height.

winkler: Good for generous crops of standard to good wine.
